notes.title: Congratulations on being admitted to DongShan University
notes.content:
DongShan University is an institution of higher learning with beautiful environment, advanced equipment and strong teaching staff. The campus has complete facilities, including swimming pools and beautiful campus gardens, creating a positive learning and living atmosphere for students. Multiple departments, such as the Art Department, Dance Department, Music Department, etc., provide students with a variety of professional choices.

The college is mainly a girls' school, and we hope that all students can understand this situation and focus on their studies and growth in the beautiful Dongshan campus. As an international university, in order to help exchange students from all over the world better integrate into campus life, the school has specially arranged study partners for them. These partners will provide guidance and support in all aspects of study and life, helping international students to adapt to the new culture and learning environment as quickly as possible.
